title: Host Terms Annex B — Listings Discount and New-Listing Promotion Figures
content:
# Annex B — Discount and New-Listing Promotion Figures

*Annex to the Roamhaven host terms. It fixes, for each space type of Roamhaven Listings, the figures on which the length-of-stay, early-bird, last-minute and new-listing discounts turn.*

| Space type | Weekly discount: fewest nights | Monthly discount: fewest nights | New-listing promotion: percent off the nightly subtotal | New-listing promotion: stays that may receive it | New-listing promotion: days after first publishing | Early-bird: fewest days between booking and check-in | Last-minute: most days between booking and check-in | How competing discounts combine |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Shared Room | 7 | 28 | 20.00% | 3 | 90 | 90 | 7 | single largest discount by amount |
| Private Room | 7 | 28 | 20.00% | 3 | 90 | 90 | 7 | single largest discount by amount |
| Entire Guest Suite | 7 | 28 | 20.00% | 3 | 90 | 90 | 7 | single largest discount by amount |
| Entire Apartment | 7 | 28 | 20.00% | 3 | 90 | 90 | 7 | single largest discount by amount |
| Entire Home | 7 | 28 | 20.00% | 3 | 90 | 90 | 7 | single largest discount by amount |
| Luxury Villa | 7 | 28 | 0.00% (not offered) | 0 (not offered) | 0 (not offered) | 90 | 7 | single largest discount by amount |

## Terms of the annex

1. The weekly discount applies to stays of at least the weekly figure in nights, and the monthly discount to stays of at least the monthly figure in nights.
2. The early-bird figure and the last-minute figure are counted in calendar days between the booking and check-in.
3. The new-listing promotion is a percent off the nightly subtotal. Its stay figure is the number of stays that may receive it, and its day figure is the number of calendar days after first publishing during which a booking may receive it. A figure of 0.00% and of 0 stays and 0 days means the promotion is not offered for that space type.
4. Where a booking qualifies for more than one discount, only the single largest discount by amount applies.

## Reading examples (hypothetical bookings)

- A 7-night stay meets the weekly figure; a 6-night stay does not.
- A booking made 90 days before check-in meets the early-bird figure; one made 89 days before does not.
- A booking made 7 days before check-in is within the last-minute figure; one made 8 days before is not.
- A Luxury Villa booking never receives the new-listing promotion, because the promotion is not offered for that space type.
